info.title: MICROSERVICE-batchinsertion-List Hotel Rooms Amenities-v3-spec
info.description: The Hotel Room Amenities API provides access to a comprehensive list of amenities available for hotel rooms. This endpoint allows users to retrieve detailed information about various amenities, which can aid travelers in selecting their accommodations based on individual preferences and needs. Typical consumers include travel agencies, hotel booking platforms, and applications that assist users in finding suitable living arrangements. By utilizing this API, developers can enhance their services with enriched data about hotel room offerings.

get.description: This endpoint allows you to fetch the list of amenities associated with the available rooms. It provides details such as features and services that enhance the guest experience.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to retrieve the amenities available in the specified rooms. The body must adhere to the defined schema for successful processing.

200.description: Successfully retrieved the available amenities for the rooms.

ListHotelRoomsAmenitiesRequest.description: This schema represents the request body for retrieving amenities related to rooms in the system. It is a placeholder indicating that a string value is expected.
